verdicts.title: Prenilpotent pairs in the E10 root system
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Tits has defined Kac-Moody groups for all root systems, over all commutative rings with unit. A central concept is the idea of a prenilpotent pair of (real) roots. In particular, writing down his group presentation explicitly would require knowing all the Weyl-group orbits of such pairs. verdicts.title: Cohomology of Complements of Toric Arrangements Associated to Root Systems
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We compute the cohomology of the complement of toric arrangements associated to root systems as representations of the corresponding Weyl groups. verdicts.title: Root subsystems of rank 2 hyperbolic root systems
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $Δ$ be a rank 2 hyperbolic root system.
